iOS 26.6 is now available for iPhone users to update. Here's everything you need to know about this update, and why it's more important than you might think.

iOS 26.6 詳細資訊

Apple released the first iOS 26.6 beta on May 26, followed by four more betas for developers and public beta testers. Last week, Apple released the iOS 26.6 Release Candidate (RC).

After two months of testing, iOS 26.6 officially rolled out to all users on Monday, July 27. You can update by going to the Settings app on your iPhone, selecting General, then Software Update. You can choose to install the update immediately or schedule it to install overnight.

iOS 26.6 有咩新功能

Apple's focus has largely shifted to iOS 27, so iOS 26.6 isn't a major update for iPhone users. However, it includes one very important change that lays the groundwork for this fall's iOS 27 update.

Siri AI is the flagship feature of iOS 27, and it requires reindexing your iPhone. This process happens in the background while you continue to use your iPhone.

iOS 27 will officially launch for all users this fall. Ahead of that, Apple says iOS 26.6 will 'optimize' your iPhone's Spotlight indexing to prepare for iOS 27. This means when you update to iOS 27 later this year, the indexing process will be much faster.

Here are the full release notes for iOS 26.6: 'This update includes bug fixes, security updates, and optimizes Spotlight indexing to prepare for iOS 27.'

Beyond the iOS 27 optimizations, iOS 26.6 doesn't include many new features. The update adds a prompt when you've blocked too many contacts. The iOS 26.6 code also shows Apple is working on a new anti-iPhone-snatching feature, but it looks like that won't launch alongside this update.

重要安全修正

Finally, iOS 26.6 patches over 75 security vulnerabilities affecting iPhones. For this reason alone, you should update your iPhone to iOS 26.6 immediately.

iOS 26.6 總結

Have you found any other new features in iOS 26.6? Have you switched to try the iOS 27 beta yet? Let us know in the comments.
